actions.action: Improve air movement around the plant so the soil dries faster
Tip the pot slightly on its side on the drip tray to help drainage
Gently aerate the soil with a skinny stake
Repot, or replace about half the existing soil with chunky amendments
Alternatively, switch the plant to semi-hydro

verdict.reason: The answer treats the problem as soggy soil and never mentions light, the confirmed cause; its chunky-mix repot matches only part of what the poster did, and none of the advice is likely to harm the plant.
